author: CBR
description:
Jason Aaron explains the hidden meaning behind Absolute Superman’s suit design with artist Rafa Sandoval: the cape is made of dust, “the ashes of Krypton,” and the suit ties back to red sunstone crystals, Kal-El’s parents, and even the rocket ship that brought him to Earth. Aaron also breaks down the dark-to-blue color shift (Issue 14 into 15) as a symbol of Superman moving from mourning toward belonging, including a connection to Martha Kent.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 14.
